# Christopher Portfolio

Current work spans pinball, CAD-to-simulation robotics, planter electronics, and Subpix.

- [Portfolio homepage](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/)

## Main Projects

- Garden Party Pinball: A full-size homebrew pinball machine in progress using FAST boards, Mission Pinball Framework, coils, switches, lamps, cabinet wiring, and playfield revisions. State: Active build with playable subsystems still being documented. Role: I am building the cabinet, playfield systems, wiring, MPF configuration, and test workflow. Media: 2 slots, 2 live, 0 placeholders.
- VividGrasp AI-Vision Robotics Arm: Stanford AI4ALL project built by a team of 10 students. It connects SolidWorks CAD, STL mesh export, URDF/PyBullet simulation, target-based vision/control input, and robotic arm joint motion. State: Completed Stanford AI4ALL team project with CAD, simulation, and prototype artifacts. Role: Head CAD designer, prepared URDF files, worked with a teammate to create a physical prototype. ([source](https://github.com/LenekyRadish/VividGrasp)). Media: 4 slots, 4 live, 0 placeholders.
- Smart Self-Watering Pot / Smart Planter PCB: A plant-watering prototype with moisture sensing, pump control, electronics packaging, and enclosure/PCB work. Photos, schematics, and test notes still need to be added. State: Prototype exists, but photos and schematic documentation need a refresh. Role: I worked on the sensing/control idea, electronics packaging, PCB direction, and enclosure constraints. Media: 2 slots, 0 live, 2 placeholders.
- Subpix: Open-source Electron, Vite, React, and TypeScript desktop app for editing .subpix files, validating JSON load/save data, exporting PNGs, and packaging for Windows. State: Working V1 app with live demo, source, editor screenshot, and Windows packaging work. Role: Built the editor, file format flow, export path, product site, and Windows packaging. ([Open app](https://subpix-editor.vercel.app/), [source](https://github.com/Chrissyuh/Subpix)). Media: 2 slots, 1 live, 1 placeholder.

## B-Level Projects

- Check-ins: Logs check-ins and shows gaps, streaks, and progress. ([project](https://check-ins-zeta.vercel.app/)). Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.

## C-Level Projects

- MIDI Practice Tool: Small Python tool for soundfonts, pedals, controls, and keyboard practice. Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
- Desmos 3D Solar System: 3D orbit scene built in Desmos to practice surfaces and performance limits. ([project](https://www.desmos.com/3d/qcjp33t4ij)). Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
- TinyGPT Experiments: Small next-token model experiments for learning training vs. instruction behavior. Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
- VEX V5 Drivetrain Prototype: Quick drivetrain prototype for gearing, shaft spacing, and packaging. Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
